levels.surface: أبوالحسن محمد بن أحمد بن علي ابن أسد الاسدي

notes: both «أبي» are bare fathers: the compiler's father at the head, and Ja'far's father (relation); «عن أبيه» is Yusuf's father (relation), so no name is invented
«1-99» is a report number: left out
«قالت ام سليمان» sits inside the saying Jabir relays: it is not a link; the Prophet is the end of the chain
